description: Eva returns as Camilo learns Luisa is pregnant, forcing him to confront impending fatherhood just as he hopes to repair his relationship with Eva. During the group's final school year in 1977, the pregnancy divides families and classmates, student politics and new romances test the friends, and Ana and José's marriage begins to fracture. Camilo's attempt to be responsible without losing Eva becomes the central conflict as the group starts making decisions that will follow them beyond school.

s02e01.description: Eva's return is bittersweet for Camilo, while Luisa's escape from boarding school prompts a reality check for everyone. Salcedo and Castro grow suspicious.

s02e02.description: Wrong assumptions favor Camilo, but not for long. Luisa's change of heart sparks a subtle act of rebellion. Trouble brews in Ana and José's marriage.

s02e03.description: The students rally for justice, except Salcedo. A parent-teacher meeting results in a heated debate and a discouraging outcome. Eva has a sneaky idea.

s02e04.description: Grief and joy intertwine in the gang's holiday, with the biggest surprise waiting in Bucaramanga. Ana's wishes to remain solo continue, to Jose's dismay.

s02e05.description: After a promising arrival in Cartagena, Camilo's dreams take a hit — both in love and work. And he's not the only one dealing with unrequited affection.

s02e06.description: Camilo strives to win Eva's favor, but an intriguing new figure complicates things for him. As Luisa struggles, she finds comfort in someone unexpected.

s02e07.description: Camilo starts to warm up to Alfredo — until he reveals his true intentions. Their new teacher brings knowledge for some and flashbacks for others.

s02e08.description: A trippy experience prompts Eva to open up to Camilo, who questions his role in her life. When Rosario opens up, bombshells drop — especially on José.

s02e09.description: Camilo shares what he discovered with the crew. Later on, he and Eva pay a visit to Rosario's home, while José returns home again.

s02e10.description: Eva mobilizes to create the student council. As change looms, Camilo ponders if apparent endings are simply the start of new beginnings.
